user_query: I am a developer working on a BIM project and I need to check if a specific key is available. Can you check the existence of the key and also provide me with the ILOD check result for another key? Additionally, I would like to merge multiple PDF files into a single document.

TaskList.description: Check the existence of a specific key in the BIM project database.
Perform an ILOD check for another specific key in the BIM project database.
Merge multiple PDF files into a single document.
